brief:
Turkey's opposition Good Party has called on the government to stop commercial vessels heading to Israeli ports, Shehab Wire reported. The party cited shipping-tracking data showing continued sailings to those destinations despite Ankara's stated position on the matter.

The demand reflects a dispute within Turkey over maritime trade with Israel. The Good Party's statement points to a gap between official Turkish policy declarations and actual enforcement, with commercial shipping to Israeli ports proceeding even as the government has announced restrictions on such activity.
